newsitem.title: USA: HFS, CUC get 2nd request from FTC.
newsitem.headline: HFS, CUC get 2nd request from FTC.

text.p: HFS Inc and CUC International Inc said Monday the U.S. Federal Trade Commission has issued a second request for information about their proposed merger.
The companies said the request came Friday and sought information primarily related to their timeshare exchange businesses.
The second request extends the FTC's review period for 20 days after the information is submitted, according to the companies.
The companies said they will meet in the next several weeks to discuss the possible divestiture of Interval International, CUC's timeshare exchange business.

The companies said in a news release they do not expect any financial impact if a divestiture is required to complete the merger. They said they see no delay to the closing of the merger, which is expected by fall.
